prior_finding_reentry: The prior b02059a-scoped router downgrade seam was repaired on the retained donor by a71d4d5: router now selects RFC8785/JCS, versions route/policy/engine identities, and requires typed versioned Entry admission bindings. The prior receipt remains valid only at its exact observed head.
finding: At the exact a71d4d5 donor head, router and inference receipt cannot consume one common current Entry-binding registry representation. Router requires a typed ENTITYOS_HCU_ENTRY_ADMISSION_BINDING/v2 mapping, while inference passes the same registry value directly to a SHA-string validator. In addition, inference now inherits/echoes the router's RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 serializer label while computing receipt_sha256 with its still-local Python sort-keys JSON encoder. This creates a serializer-label/actual-byte mismatch and blocks a truthful single JCS Entry->Route->Inference identity chain.

counterhypotheses.hypothesis: The router v2 binding mapping can transparently satisfy inference because only event_sha256 matters.
counterhypotheses.reason: Inference validates the entire registry value as a lowercase SHA-256 string instead of extracting/validating the typed mapping.

counterhypotheses.hypothesis: Importing HASH_SERIALIZATION_SCHEMA from the JCS router is sufficient to make inference receipt identity JCS.
counterhypotheses.reason: Receipt identity bytes are still produced by the local Python json.dumps canonicalizer before SHA-256. Serializer identity is determined by bytes, not by the imported label.

required_repair_order: Reuse the router's one versioned Entry-binding resolver, or a single shared non-authority resolver, in inference; do not retain two registry schemas.
Introduce a new versioned inference-receipt identity for the JCS path; preserve HCU_INFERENCE_RECEIPT/v1 historical bytes without silent reinterpretation.
Compute new inference receipt identity with the selected entry_canonicalization_v1 canonicalize implementation and explicitly echo the selected canonicalization schema.
Reject missing, legacy, unknown or downgraded route/Entry canonicalization at the inference boundary.
Run deterministic regressions for one valid v2 Entry binding through route and receipt plus bare-binding, wrong-schema and Python-JSON-vs-JCS poison cases.
Only after source convergence, execute the exact combined Entry -> route -> inference -> GRID10 path in an authorized isolated executor.

coordination.note: This is deterministic source/interface analysis only.

next_exact_gate: Fuse the inference producer onto the same versioned JCS Entry-binding and canonicalization path already used by the current router, then run exact combined Entry/route/inference/GRID10 regressions on an actually-started authorized isolated executor before physical loader-lease runtime promotion.
